title: Everybody Hates Chris: Reunion
overview: After years apart, the original cast of Everybody Hates Chris reunites for a heartfelt and comedic look at how their lives have changed since the 1980s. Chris returns to Brooklyn for a special community event, only to find himself navigating old friendships, new responsibilities, and the same chaotic family energy he thought he’d outgrown. Blending nostalgia, humor, and modern-day challenges, the reunion brings the beloved characters back together for one unforgettable celebration.
